shared.style: Painterly gaslamp-fantasy illustration, Dungeonpunk: a soot-stained industrial harbour city of wet black stone, riveted brass and verdigris copper, lit by amber charge-lamps in drifting grey brume fog. Loose confident oil-paint brushwork over precise ink line, muted desaturated colours with warm light accents, atmospheric depth, high detail in the foreground, soft haze in the distance. A tabletop RPG sourcebook painting, grounded and lived-in.
shared.palette_use: Wet stone and shadows color #1E1B18; pipes, fittings and lamp housings color #B5893A; copper roofs and domes color #4E8C7D; every lamp, lit window and charge cell glows color #F2A541; furnace mouths and refinery light on the fog color #D9622B; fog and sea haze color #9AA3A6; paper, notices and sails color #E6DCC3; Compact banners and warning paint color #8C2A1C.
shared.mood: Grim streets, hopeful crews: hard industry and soot, with warm light in every window.
shared.reference_line: Match the painting style, brushwork and colour palette of image 0.

images.scene: A single street corner of Ashford Roads at dusk, a gaslamp-fantasy harbour city, painted as a style study.

subjects.description: A tall brass charge-lamp on an iron post, its glass cylinder glowing color #F2A541, fog curling around it
A narrow black-stone townhouse with a verdigris copper bay window, color #4E8C7D, and riveted brass drainpipes, color #B5893A
Pinned paper notices on a wet wall, color #E6DCC3, one stamped with a rust-red Compact seal, color #8C2A1C
Two refinery stacks far behind the roofs, their mouths glowing color #D9622B into the grey fog, color #9AA3A6

images.composition: Square vignette. Along the bottom edge, a neat row of eight painted paint chips in the palette colours, like a painter's swatch strip on the same canvas.
images.lighting: Dusk: cool grey fog, warm amber lamp pools, orange refinery glow on the cloud base.

images.scene: Ashford Roads seen from the harbour at dusk: a gaslit industrial port city of eleven thousand people, stacked up a hill from the water.

subjects.description: The Compact refinery on the left: a walled complex of tall brick stacks and domed brume tanks, furnace mouths glowing color #D9622B, pipelines running down to its own pier
The Long Quay: a long stone and timber pier with tall-masted sailing ships berthed along it, sails color #E6DCC3, crates, cranes and gangways, charge-lamps color #F2A541 along its length
One sky ship: a wooden hull hanging under brass-ribbed lift envelopes, a glowing brume engine at its stern color #F2A541, moored to a tall iron mast at the end of the quay
subjects.position: upper right, small against the sky

subjects.description: The old town climbing the hill: steep black-stone roofs, verdigris domes color #4E8C7D, a clock tower, hundreds of lit windows
Grey brume fog color #9AA3A6 rolling in across the dark harbour water and swallowing the lower streets

images.composition: Wide cinematic panorama, horizon a third from the top, the quay leading the eye from bottom right into the city. Leave calm sky in the upper left for a title.
images.lighting: Last light behind the city, amber lamps coming on, refinery glow reflecting orange on the water and the underside of the smoke.

camera.angle: from a boat low on the water
camera.depth_of_field: deep focus, haze increasing with distance

images.scene: An illustrated bird's-eye map of the whole harbour city of Ashford Roads, drawn on aged ledger paper color #E6DCC3 in ink and watercolour wash, like a map page from a tabletop RPG city sourcebook. North is up.

subjects.description: West edge: the Coast Road, a pale dirt road coming in from the left edge across grey ash fields color #9AA3A6, to a gatehouse in a landward stone wall
North-west: the refinery, a walled complex of tall stacks and domed tanks with brass pipelines color #B5893A, its own small pier, a faint orange glow color #D9622B
Refinery Row: one wide straight street running east from the refinery gate, lined with large houses and gardens
The old town: dense steep roofs and narrow crooked lanes; a columned courthouse with a clock tower; a small chapel with a clock face; a white domed hall with brass coils on its roof
The harbour: a curved bay of dark water; the Long Quay, a long straight pier with tall ships moored along it and a tall iron mooring mast at its tip; a fish market on the waterfront; a quay-side inn
Sewer outfalls: arched culvert mouths in the harbour wall below the rich street
subjects.position: right edge of the old town, at the water

subjects.description: Open sea fading into brume fog at the east and south edges of the map, color #9AA3A6

images.composition: Top-down bird's-eye view with slight perspective on buildings, the whole city fits inside a decorative border. A compass rose in the bottom left sea. An empty decorative title cartouche at the top centre. Clean margins. The map has no lettering or labels anywhere.
images.lighting: Even daylight, as on a printed map; buildings cast short soft shadows to the south-east.

images.scene: Refinery Row, Ashford's rich street, at night: the refinery's heat keeps the fog off this one street while it fills every lane around it.

subjects.description: A wide clean cobbled avenue with tall townhouses, wrought-iron balconies, brass charge-lamps color #F2A541 every few paces
subjects.position: centre, receding to a vanishing point

subjects.description: A sharp-edged wall of grey fog color #9AA3A6 standing at the mouth of each side lane, never crossing into the street
The refinery gate and stacks at the end of the avenue, glowing color #D9622B
A well-dressed couple passing a street grate in the cobbles; warm steam rising from the grate

images.lighting: Bright amber lamps on the clear street, cold grey outside it, orange glow at the end.

images.scene: Inside Sallow's Exchange, the public information broker of Ashford Roads: a crowded counting-room where crews come to find work, ships and each other.

subjects.description: Walls covered floor to ceiling in pinned paper notices and commissions, color #E6DCC3, some stamped with rust-red seals color #8C2A1C
A tall dark-wood high desk with brass rails, ledgers and a small charge-lamp color #F2A541; behind it a sharp-dressed fox-kin woman broker in a waistcoat, quill raised
A queue of would-be sailors of many peoples waiting on the worn floor, packs on their backs

images.composition: Interior seen from the doorway, the high desk as the focal point.
images.lighting: Grey daylight through tall grimy windows mixing with amber lamp light; dust in the air.

images.scene: The Long Quay of Ashford Roads in the morning as fog burns off: the pier where the outbound ships berth.

subjects.description: A fast, handsome three-masted ship loading at a gangway, its sails color #E6DCC3, a gilded figurehead
Dock workers, crates, a steam crane with brass fittings color #B5893A, coiled ropes, gulls
A tall iron mooring mast at the end of the quay with a sky ship tethered to it, its brume engine glowing color #F2A541

images.composition: The pier runs diagonally from bottom left into the distance.
images.lighting: Low morning sun breaking through thinning grey fog color #9AA3A6.

images.scene: Inside the Binding House, the Compact's licensed hall where brume possibility is bound into a person and they leave classed.

subjects.description: A tall white hall with a ribbed dome, brass coils color #B5893A spiralling up the columns
Rows of tall glass cylinders filled with slowly swirling warm grey brume color #9AA3A6
A stern dwarf binder in a leather apron beside a brass binding chair at the centre
A Compact banner color #8C2A1C hanging above a clerk's ledger desk

images.composition: Symmetrical, the binding chair at the centre.
images.lighting: Cold white light from the dome, a faint warm glow inside the cylinders.

images.scene: Inside the Lantern and Lee, the one inn on Ashford's quay that takes monsterkin: cheap, loud and warm.

subjects.description: A low-beamed common room packed with sailors of every people, including big monsterkin with horns and tusks, drinking and laughing
A broad half-orc innkeeper behind a scarred bar, polishing a tankard
Ship lanterns color #F2A541 hanging from the beams, a fire in a stone hearth

images.composition: Warm crowded interior, view from a corner table.
images.lighting: Warm amber light, grey fog pressing at the dark windows.

images.scene: The Undercourses, the sewers under Refinery Row: old stone culverts warm with refinery run-off, a Dungeonpunk dungeon.

subjects.description: A vaulted brick and black-stone culvert with a channel of dark water and faintly glowing run-off color #D9622B
Rusted brass pipes and valves color #B5893A along the walls, dripping
Rats on a ledge; far ahead, one shaft of daylight falling through a street grate into a cistern
A single adventurer's charge-lamp color #F2A541 lighting the foreground

images.composition: One-point perspective down the tunnel toward the shaft of light.
images.lighting: Darkness, warm steam, one amber lamp, a white shaft of sun far ahead.

images.scene: Dawn on the Coast Road: the way into Ashford from the mainland, through the refinery's grey ash fields, to the city gate.

subjects.description: A dirt road through flat fields of grey ash color #9AA3A6, a lone carter's wagon
A stone gatehouse in the landward wall, notices pinned beside the arch color #E6DCC3, a guard with a ledger
The refinery stacks glowing color #D9622B above the walls

images.composition: The road leads from the bottom edge to the gate.
images.lighting: Cold dawn, pale sun through ash haze, orange glow from the stacks.
